usageNotes: Use this to retrieve historical RRD time-series statistics (disk usage, I/O throughput, etc.) for a specific storage pool on a given node. The node must be online and the caller needs either Datastore.Audit or Datastore.AllocateSpace on the storage path. The returned array of objects has no guaranteed fixed schema — field availability depends on the storage type and what Proxmox has been collecting.

examples.summary: Fetch last 24 hours of storage RRD data for local-lvm on pve1, using AVERAGE consolidation

tips: Omitting 'cf' lets Proxmox choose its default; supply 'MAX' when you want to catch peak usage spikes rather than averages.
RRD data is pre-aggregated — shorter timeframes give finer resolution (hour = minute-level points), longer ones are coarser.
If the storage is currently unmounted or unavailable, the API may return an empty array or an error rather than historical data.
Use 'week' or 'month' timeframes for trend analysis; use 'hour' or 'day' for recent incident investigation.
